bio.text: Kathy Hochul is the Governor of New York; Hochul assumed office on August 24, 2021, and is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Hochul was born in Buffalo, received a B.A. from Syracuse University in 1980 and a J.D. from Catholic University in 1983.
The earlier offices include Lieutenant Governor of New York from 2015 to 2021, U.S. Representative for New York's 26th District from 2011 to 2013, and Erie County Clerk from 2007 to 2011.
